title: Exercise
description: Language-neutral facts about one exercise. Allowed values for each field are listed in taxonomy.json.

id.description: Permanent identifier, equal to the file name.

mechanic.description: One of taxonomy.mechanics. Required for strength exercises.

equipment.description: Every piece of equipment the exercise needs, from taxonomy.equipment. Empty means no equipment.

metrics.description: What to log for one set, one of taxonomy.metricSets.

variantOf.description: Id of the base exercise this one varies.

replacedBy.description: Id of the exercise that replaces a deprecated one.
